caption: The drawing displays a design study for pottery decoration, featuring a primary section with hand-drawn blue floral motifs and stylized leaf elements on a tan background wash. There are two main flowers depicted prominently in a deep blue hue, both with multiple petals and dotted details around them. Below the flowers, three large, overlapping leaf or petal shapes, also shaded in blue, extend downward and outwards, with some dots at the center bottom indicating further detail. Above the floral motifs, blue uppercase text reads: "F. A. VOORHEE & CO. KINGSTON NY 2," with horizontal lines above and below the text. In the lower right corner, there is an outlined drawing of a pottery vessel or crock, with the floral design reproduced within its outline, showing how the decoration would appear on the actual object. The entire design uses shades of blue on a beige paper, and there is a signature “Chas. Saseau” in the lower left area.
title: Crock
